title: Deer wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Deer body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#b5651d"/>
  <!-- Deer chest / belly lighter -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#e0a96d"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="33" y="82" width="6" height="12" rx="3" fill="#8b4513"/>
  <rect x="61" y="82" width="6" height="12" rx="3" fill="#8b4513"/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x="33" y="90" width="6" height="5" rx="2" fill="#5a2d0c"/>
  <rect x="61" y="90" width="6" height="5" rx="2" fill="#5a2d0c"/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x="43" y="46" width="14" height="16" rx="5" fill="#b5651d"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="40" rx="16" ry="14" fill="#c47a2b"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="30" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#c47a2b" transform="rotate(-20 32 30)"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="30" rx="5" ry="8" fill="#c47a2b" transform="rotate(20 68 30)"/>
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="31" rx="2.5" ry="5" fill="#f0c090" transform="rotate(-20 33 31)"/>
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="31" rx="2.5" ry="5" fill="#f0c090" transform="rotate(20 67 31)"/>
  <!-- Antlers -->
  <path d="M38 28 L32 14 L28 18" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M32 20 L26 16" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M62 28 L68 14 L72 18" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M68 20 L74 16" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="39" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#2a1a0a"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="39" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#2a1a0a"/>
  <circle cx="44.5" cy="38" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="58.5" cy="38" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#3a2010"/>
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="47" rx="1.2" ry="0.8" fill="#6b4a30"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M46 52 Q50 55 54 52" stroke="#3a2010" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <path d="M50 12 L40 30 Q50 33 60 30 Z" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
  <!-- Hat stripes -->
  <path d="M43.5 22 Q50 24 56.5 22" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Hat pom pom -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="10" r="3" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <!-- Hat star decoration -->
  <polygon points="50,16 51.5,20 56,20 52.5,22.5 54,27 50,24.5 46,27 47.5,22.5 44,20 48.5,20" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <!-- Spots on body -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="68" r="2" fill="#e0a96d"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="66" r="2" fill="#e0a96d"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="62" r="1.5" fill="#e0a96d"/>
</svg>
